subject: values
title: The Blue Umbrella's Lesson
objective: Understand generosity: why Binya sharing her umbrella mattered more than owning it.

story_beats.text: Binya had a beautiful blue umbrella — the prettiest in the village. Everyone wanted it.
In the end, Binya gave her umbrella to someone who needed it more. She felt happier than when she owned it.

interactions.prompt: Why did Binya feel happy after giving away her umbrella?
options: Sharing made someone else happy too

interactions.prompt: You have one chocolate and a friend has none. The generous choice is...

feedback.correct: You understand what Binya learned — sharing multiplies happiness!
feedback.retry: Think about how the OTHER person felt. What would kindness do?

off_screen: Give something of yours to someone today — a toy, a drawing, your time.
parent_note: Values: generosity, empathy, understanding others' feelings.
